### The Cleansing of God's People
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/cleansing-gods-people
Passage: Zechariah 13:1-9
Points:
- God provides an abundant fountain of grace rather than a trickle, generously cleansing His people from sin and shame.
- The cleansing completely removes the spirit of impurity, doing away with idolatry and false prophets.
- Divine mercy knows no limits, reaching and forgiving even the worst offenses and sinners.
- This comprehensive purification is secured through Jesus Christ, the true Shepherd who was struck on behalf of His flock.
